description: This file 'tunerstudio.cpp' implements the binary protocol for Tuner Studio interface in the rusEfi engine control firmware. It manages communication commands such as query, output channel snapshot, read/write configuration pages, CRC checks, burn (save) changes, and some diagnostic functions. It interfaces with external hardware like Bluetooth modules and serial ports, and contains logic for handling Tuner Studio protocol packets and responses.

methods.name: runBinaryProtocolLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing incoming Tuner Studio protocol commands over a serial-like channel.

methods.name: setTsSpeed
methods.description: Set the baud rate for Tuner Studio serial communication.

methods.name: printTsStats
methods.description: Print internal statistics and counters related to Tuner Studio communication.

methods.name: handleQueryCommand
methods.description: Handle Tuner Studio query command, typically for handshake and status.

methods.name: handleTestCommand
methods.description: Respond to a test/diagnostic command with version info and test counters.

methods.name: handleExecuteCommand
methods.description: Process a text execute command, usually to run console commands.

methods.name: handlePlainCommand
methods.description: Process simple, non-CRC commands such as hello, test, and protocol info.

methods.name: tunerStudioHandleCrcCommand
methods.description: Main dispatcher for handling incoming CRC-framed protocol commands.

methods.name: startTunerStudioConnectivity
methods.description: Initialize and start the Tuner Studio communication interface and thread.
